caption: The drawing depicts a stylized horse facing to the left, rendered in muted tones of gray, brown, and dull yellow. The horse's body, legs, and head are primarily light gray and covered with evenly spaced reddish-brown spots. The mane, ear tips, nose, and hooves are darker gray, while the tail is colored brown with similar reddish-brown spots as the body. The horse wears a saddle that is outlined in yellow and shaded with olive green, along with a black harness that runs from behind the front legs, across the body, and around the neck, featuring a circular ornament where the straps meet. The background is plain and off-white, and there are no additional objects or details apart from the depiction of the horse. In the lower right corner, the text "MARALIAN" is written.
title: Toy Horse
